checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Red paint is now blue, but it reads as a fairly saturated cobalt/royal blue rather than a deep navy.

must.item: Car retains shape, position, windows, tyres, trim, lights
must.why: The geometry, windows, wheels, red tail light, plate and trim all match the original.

must.item: Shading and reflections consistent with sunny lighting
must.why: Highlights on the roof, door and bumper are kept and the paint stays glossy.

must.item: Street, houses and other areas unchanged
must.why: The background looks the same, and the distant red car is still red.
The framing is identical at 640x384, with no crop.

faults.what: The blue is brighter and more saturated than a deep navy. It looks like royal or cobalt blue.
Some of the original paint shading looks slightly flatter, for example on the lower door.

summary: The hatchback is cleanly recoloured to blue with the gloss, reflections and the rest of the scene intact, but the shade is brighter than a true navy.
